Fenced JSON in model stdout: what the balanced scan accepts, and what it still rejects

scripts/cc-triage.mjs called JSON.parse(out) on raw model stdout. The prompt forbids markdown fences twice, the model emitted one anyway, and the retry re-rolled a byte-identical prompt, so the same wrapper came back and CC adoption froze at 2.1.231 (run 31672298470). Pick a payload to run both parsers, live, in this page.

  The scan in this page is the function shipped by this PR, copied verbatim from
  scripts/cc-triage.mjs. The failure-preserving cases are the point: a fenced
  [] still trips the M134 empty-array guard, a fenced object still fails
  result is not array, and non-JSON still writes the parse_failed sentinel.
  Assertions for all eight live in tests/integration/test-cc-triage.sh.
